title: .tmp file not cleaned up when write_all fails mid-write (disk full path)
description: kith-attach/src/lib.rs:117 write_blob_streaming: if write_all returns Err (e.g. disk full), the '?' propagates the error but the .tmp file is left stranded on disk. Same issue in write_blob (line 61). The rename never happens so the final blob path is not created, but the orphaned .tmp accumulates. Fix: add a cleanup guard that removes the .tmp file whenever the function returns an error after the file is created.
